reviews.comment: Dr. Pun is a brilliant instructor that cares about his students. He did an excellent job balancing the theory of differential equations with practice and examples. I would happily take him again if he were not leaving A&M.

He is the sweetest! Cons: 80% of your grade is tests, only takes off points in increments of 5 on tests so like your possible grades are 95,90,85, etc. Pros: Great at explaining, not too heavy on the homework, does reviews that are basically the tests, cares about your learning AND your grade!

Dr. Pun is one of the best explainers that I have encountered in college. He reminds me of my high school math teachers. During spring 21 semester (covid), he gave take-home exams and graded very fairly. Would highly recommend taking him.

His reviews and office hours are very helpful, more than the lectures as sometimes Professor Pun gets bogged down on detail and theory. Even so, still attend as important material you'll need to know come from lecture. His lecture notes are sometimes unclear, but are great . DRILL and PRACTICE and you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Pun cares a great deal about his students. His lectures are incredibly clear, and he writes down everything instead of reading from a PowerPoint or such. He is kind and tries to explain the "why" to the material.

I had Simon both semesters this year and I have to say he was a lot better this time around. His examples are easy to follow and he always posts his notes after each week which are good to study. I thought differential equations was going to be hard, but he was pretty good with it.

Hes a good choice. Sometimes gets caught up in theory of diff. eq. but his examples are pretty alright. The review is more or less like the tests and you shouldnt be surprised by anything if you pay attention in class. Easy to access through email.

Lectures are confusing, there is no point in going. I self-taught through homework and notes he posts after. Exams were way more difficult than it should be. Gives major curves but if you want to understand the material, do not take him. The CURVES are the best thing about this class and the only reason I got an A.

Honestly not that bad of a professor, just tends to get more into the conceptual side of the subject rather than the examples (which other professors do). Not an impossible class at all, just have to review on your own time and do the homework if nothing clicks in class. Most low ratings probably didn't do Khan Academy or some other review lol
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Pun isn't the greatest, but he is still pretty good. He explains the material very conceptually at times, and likes to show you where the ideas come from. Some lectures would leave me lost, but reviewing my notes always helped and eventually lead to a deeper understanding. Tests are rather straightforward, and he gave decent curves when necessary.

He makes this class more difficult than it needs to be. The lectures are absolutely useless and the tests are totally different than what he goes over. You do not learn from him, you have to self-learn from the homeworks assigned. Amy Austin's reviews are the only thing that got me through this class. Please please avoid him at all costs
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hes a good professor. He gets the job done, I didnt have any trouble doing well in the class. Granted there were times when I had to learn some material on my own but thats the situation for almost every single class. And even so, every time I emailed him about a question he always responds within 30 minutes. Just put in the work outside of class.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I learned more from watching YouTube tutorials than I did from going to class. In fact, I stopped going to class and only watched YouTube tutorials and did well on the subsequent tests. Tests are fair, you need to be able to do most of WebAssign to do well in this class.

Our class size went from 80ish to 20 over the course of the semester. The majority of my learning came from watching webassign videos on the HW. I strongly recommend doing the HW a little ahead of time since the schedule is off by a week and attending Amy Austin's Reviews. He's decent but def not the best.

Tests are far harder than anything you will see outside of his lectures or HW. He is horrible to try and contact. He only goes over theoretical concepts, no examples. Horrible prof, the worst I have had yet at A&M. PLEASE AVOID AT ALL COST.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader
